obligation: State data breach notification (Florida worked example)
citation: Fla. Stat. 501.171(3)-(5). Each other state where affected residents live applies its own statute (not reviewed here)
trigger: Breach of security of personal information of Florida residents
deadline: Individuals: as expeditiously as practicable and no later than 30 days after determination of the breach or reason to believe one occurred (15 more days if good cause is given in writing to the department within 30 days). Department of Legal Affairs: no later than 30 days, if 500 or more Floridians. Consumer reporting agencies: without unreasonable delay, if more than 1,000 individuals
notify: Affected Florida residents; Florida Department of Legal Affairs (500 or more); nationwide consumer reporting agencies (more than 1,000)

obligation: Bank service provider notification (IT/data processors serving banks)
deadline: As soon as possible when an incident materially disrupts/degrades covered services for 4+ hours
notify: Bank-designated point of contact at each affected banking organization customer
